scope: Strict incremental audit of the 29 manifest papers added through exact-title cache resolution (records with resolutionSourceUrl). Evidence was read from the available structured full-text cache tmp/paper-corpus/<arxivId>/paper.json because tmp/paper-digests/ is absent; no download, web lookup, scripts/data edit, generated-site edit, or source-code edit was performed.
decisionPolicy: Approve only a named dataset explicitly used for model training, pre-training, fine-tuning, or training demonstrations. Reject evaluation/test/benchmark-only use, reward-only data, methods/models/metrics, unnamed/private constructed data, future releases, and synthetic generated output that is not an approved named training dataset. Every decision must carry a local source locator and reason; URLs are included only when literally present in audited local evidence or inherited from the already-verified v2 canonical record.
